title: Vercel vs Cloudflare: Which one to use for hosting and deployment?
description:
Everyone picks Vercel because it's easy, then quietly pays for that easy.

Cloudflare sits closer to the metal so the bill barely moves, and the only reason people avoid it is the dashboard. That excuse died when the CLI plugin shipped.

(comment “CLI” and I'll drop the whole walkthrough in your DMs 🚀)
